urdu transliteration: Ya Ali yeh marhala dushwaar hai\nMalika-e-Tathir, hai bazaar hai
english translation text: O Ali, this trial is unbearably hard\nThe Queen of Purity stands humiliated in the bazaar.

urdu transliteration: Be-rada Qur'an ki hain aayatein\nKhoon rota Abid-e-beemar hai
english translation text: Unveiled like Qur'anic verses,\nThe sick worshipper weeps blood.

urdu transliteration: Hai tamanna maut ki Sajjad ko\nSar khule Zainab hai aur darbaar hai
english translation text: Sajjad wishes for death,\nZainab stands bare-headed in the tyrant's court.

urdu transliteration: Maaro na pathar yeh Fizza ne kaha\nSar hai jis ka khuld ka sardar hai
english translation text: “Do not throw stones,” Fizza cries\n“This is the head of Paradise's leader.”

urdu transliteration: Jin ko sooraj ne kabhi dekha na tha\nUnke aage majma-e-aghyar hai
english translation text: Those whom even the sun never saw unveiled\nNow face a crowd of enemies.

urdu transliteration: Is qadar maare tumanche shaam tak\nDard ki kul daastaan rukhsaar hai
english translation text: So many slaps till evening\nTheir cheeks tell the whole story of suffering.

urdu transliteration: Aal-e-Ahmed ko rulane ke liye\nSang thaame har shaqi tayyar hai
english translation text: Every cruel man stands ready with stones\nTo make the family of Ahmad (Prophet saww) weep.

urdu transliteration: Shams baaghi jisko ummat ne kaha\nMustafa ki 'Itrat-e-Athaar hai
english translation text: Shams (poet), the one they called a rebel\nIs the pure lineage of Mustafa.
